Colour flextable cells by group

Source: R/flextable.R
phw_flextable_groups.Rd

Colours cells by the group they contain, using the same colours as your charts. With a key, each group keeps its colour across tables, charts and reports (see phw_colour_key()).

Usage

phw_flextable_groups(
  x,
  j,
  key = NULL,
  palette = phw_default_palette(),
  values = NULL,
  what = c("background", "text"),
  rows = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A flextable.

j

Column that holds the groups, unquoted as in dplyr. A string or a position works too.

key, palette, values

Passed to phw_colour_key() as name, palette and fixed.

what

Colour the cell "background" or the "text"?

rows

Colour the whole row (TRUE) or only column j?

Value

A flextable.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  df <- data.frame(Group = c("Group A", "Group B", "Group C", "Unknown"),
                   Cases = c(120, 85, 64, 9))
  phw_flextable(df) |>
    phw_flextable_groups(Group)

  # Colour the text instead, across the whole row
  phw_flextable(df) |>
    phw_flextable_groups(Group, what = "text", rows = TRUE)
}
